issues.title: WSL 2 mirrored networking breaks NFS mounts (“Connection timed out”)
issues.next_action_reason: Community found the root cause (NFS uses privileged source ports <1024, blocked under mirrored networking) and a workaround (mount -o noresvport). Acknowledge, capture the workaround in docs, and open an engineering item for resvport handling under mirrored mode.
issues.suggested_reply:
Thanks all — and thanks @r-teller / @kedama222 for narrowing this down. The key finding is that NFS defaults to a privileged *source* port (<1024) and mirrored networking isn't preserving those, so the SYN never completes (Wireshark sees SYN+ACK, tcpdump doesn't). Confirmed workaround for anyone hitting this:

```
sudo mount -t nfs -o noresvport <host>:/export /mnt/point
```
(for autofs, add `noresvport` in `/etc/auto.net`).

We're tracking the underlying privileged-port behaviour under mirrored networking as a bug. Note `-o noresvport` requires the NFS server to allow non-reserved ports (`insecure` in `/etc/exports`).
